function f<T = U, U = number>(x: T): T { return x; }
type Box<T = T> = { v: T };
interface Q<T = Array<{ x: U }>, U = number> { t: T }
function h<T, U = 1, V = Array<V>, W = { w: W }>(): void {}
type F = <T = (u: U) => void, U = 1>() => void;
type C<T = U extends infer V ? V : never, U = 1> = T;
type Sh<T = <T>(t: T) => T> = T;
interface Nd<T = Nd> { v?: T }
type A<T = B> = T;
type B<U = A> = U;
type Ok<T, U = T, V = Array<U>> = [T, U, V];
const ok: Ok<number> = [1, 2, [3]];
console.log(f(3), h, ok);
